content.title: About Cow Protocol (COW)
content.description: Cow Protocol is a decentralized exchange protocol that utilizes batch auctions and intents to provide users with MEV protection and optimized trading prices.

content.title: What is Walrus about?
content.description: Walrus is a developer platform enabling data markets for the AI era, making data across all industries trustworthy, provable, monetizable, and secure. From AI agents to data markets and decentralized finance, Walrus empowers builders, users, and intelligent systems to control, verify, and create value from the world’s data.

content.title: About Chainlink (LINK)
content.description: Chainlink is the industry-standard decentralized oracle network that connects smart contracts with real-world data and off-chain systems.

content.title: What is pump.fun?
content.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin generator/launchpad that simplifies the process of creating tokens, allowing users to launch their own memecoins without needing technical expertise.

content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: What is Plume about?
content.description: Plume is the first RWAfi L1 network focused on crypto natives, building infrastructure to connect the real world and crypto markets. It challenges the traditional view of RWAs by introducing new, crypto-first RWA use cases, including RWA derivatives, speculation, borrowing, lending, yield farming, and more, rather than simply replicating traditional finance on the blockchain.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: About Akedo (AKE)
content.description: Akedo is a multi-agent artificial intelligence framework designed to enable autonomous content creation and intelligent collaboration within the gaming industry.

content.title: What is Cosmos Hub (ATOM)?
content.description: The Cosmos network consists of many independent, parallel blockchains, called zones, each powered by classical Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) consensus protocols like Tendermint. Some zones act as hubs with respect to other zones, allowing many zones to interoperate through a shared hub.

content.title: What is Avalanche?
content.description: Avalanche is a general-purpose blockchain platform founded by Cornell University professor Emin Gün Sirer. Developers can deploy decentralized applications such as decentralized finance, gaming, and NFTs via smart contracts. Validators secure the network through a proof-of-stake consensus protocol, which allows for fast and low-cost transaction processing.

content.title: About Velvet (VELVET)
content.description: Velvet is an AI-powered onchain trading and portfolio management terminal designed to integrate spot, perpetuals, and yield strategies into a single vertically integrated system.

content.title: About Litecoin
content.description: Litecoin is a peer-to-peer digital currency designed to enable instant, near-zero cost payments to individuals and merchants worldwide.
